name: Dropdown Menu
import: import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuPortal, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuSubContent } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"

DropdownMenu.name: defaultOpen
DropdownMenu.description:
Whether the menu is initially open.

To render a controlled menu, use the `open` prop instead.

DropdownMenu.name: loopFocus
DropdownMenu.description:
Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item
when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

DropdownMenu.name: highlightItemOnHover
DropdownMenu.description:
Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them.
Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.

DropdownMenu.name: modal
DropdownMenu.description:
Determines if the menu enters a modal state when open.
- `true`: user interaction is limited to the menu: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled.
- `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed.

On touch devices, a `true` modal blocks outside taps but leaves the page scrollable unless the popup spans nearly the full viewport width, matching native iOS behavior.

Nested menus ignore this prop, and menus opened by hover are never modal.

DropdownMenu.name: onOpenChange
DropdownMenu.description: Event handler called when the menu is opened or closed.

DropdownMenu.name: onOpenChangeComplete
DropdownMenu.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the menu is opened or closed.

DropdownMenu.name: onItemHighlighted
DropdownMenu.description:
Callback fired when an item is highlighted or unhighlighted.
Receives the highlighted item element (or `undefined` if no item is highlighted) and details
containing the reason for the change, the event, and the item's text label.
The `reason` can be:
- `'keyboard'`: the highlight changed due to keyboard navigation.
- `'pointer'`: the highlight changed due to pointer hovering. The event may be a `MouseEvent`
  rather than a `PointerEvent`.
- `'none'`: the highlight changed for another reason, such as automatic highlighting while
  filtering, the item list changing, or the popup opening or closing.

DropdownMenu.name: open
DropdownMenu.description: Whether the menu is currently open.

DropdownMenu.name: orientation
DropdownMenu.description:
The visual orientation of the menu.
Controls whether roving focus uses up/down or left/right arrow keys.

DropdownMenu.name: disabled
DropdownMenu.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

DropdownMenu.name: closeParentOnEsc
DropdownMenu.description:
When in a submenu, determines whether pressing the Escape key
closes the entire menu, or only the current child menu.

DropdownMenu.name: actionsRef
DropdownMenu.description:
A ref to imperative actions.
- `unmount`: Ends the closing phase of the menu after an externally controlled closing animation finishes.
  Call `preventUnmountOnClose()` in `onOpenChange` first, otherwise the menu completes closing on its own.
  Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by `keepMounted` on the portal.
- `close`: Closes the menu imperatively when called.

DropdownMenu.name: triggerId
DropdownMenu.description:
ID of the trigger that the menu is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled menu.
There's no need to specify this prop when the menu is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

DropdownMenu.name: defaultTriggerId
DropdownMenu.description:
ID of the trigger that the menu is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open menu.

DropdownMenu.name: handle
DropdownMenu.description:
A handle to associate the menu with a trigger.
If specified, allows external triggers to control the menu's open state.

DropdownMenu.name: children
DropdownMenu.description:
The content of the menu.
This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.

DropdownMenuPortal.name: keepMounted
DropdownMenuPortal.description: Whether to keep the portal mounted in the DOM while the popup is hidden.

DropdownMenuPortal.name: container
DropdownMenuPortal.description: A parent element to render the portal element into.

DropdownMenuPortal.name: className
DropdownMenuPortal.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

DropdownMenuPortal.name: render
DropdownMenuPortal.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

DropdownMenuPortal.name: style
DropdownMenuPortal.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

DropdownMenuTrigger.name: disabled
DropdownMenuTrigger.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

DropdownMenuTrigger.name: handle
DropdownMenuTrigger.description: A handle to associate the trigger with a menu.

DropdownMenuTrigger.name: payload
DropdownMenuTrigger.description: A payload to pass to the menu when it is opened.

DropdownMenuTrigger.name: delay
DropdownMenuTrigger.description:
How long to wait before the menu may be opened on hover. Specified in milliseconds.

Requires the `openOnHover` prop.

DropdownMenuTrigger.name: closeDelay
DropdownMenuTrigger.description:
How long to wait before closing the menu that was opened on hover.
Specified in milliseconds.

Requires the `openOnHover` prop.

DropdownMenuTrigger.name: openOnHover
DropdownMenuTrigger.description: Whether the menu should also open when the trigger is hovered.

DropdownMenuTrigger.description:

via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

DropdownMenuContent.name: finalFocus
DropdownMenuContent.type: boolean | React.RefObject<HTMLElement> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void)
DropdownMenuContent.description:
Determines the element to focus when the menu is closed.

- `false`: Do not move focus.
- `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (trigger or previously focused element).
- `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element.
- `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`).
  Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

DropdownMenuContent.name: align
DropdownMenuContent.description:
How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

Submenus and menubars default to `'start'`.

DropdownMenuContent.name: side
DropdownMenuContent.description:
Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against.
May automatically change to avoid collisions.

Submenus and vertical menubars default to `'inline-end'`.

DropdownMenuContent.name: sideOffset
DropdownMenuContent.description:
Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
- `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
- `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

DropdownMenuContent.name: alignOffset
DropdownMenuContent.description:
Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
- `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
- `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.
